gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-glegoo: Outrun Future draws wide-spaced outlines with a marker-nib line that ignores direction, giving a synthwave bravado. But Glegoo brings big counters and a tall lowercase that feel refined and editorial, a quiet counterweight to the neon.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hanuman: Wide-set, authoritative lettering: Outrun Future keeps its outline constant and its bowls unthinned, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Hanuman keeps a high-waisted, traditional serif texture going smoothly, line after line.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking strip of sans text with its letters held open, under the fixed-nib, vintage-military look of Over There. Crisp throughout, it carries paragraphs without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-montagu-slab: Bent-paperclip geometry, technical and wide-curved, is what Ozone does best. Montagu Slab does the opposite job, a restful serif line with robust downstrokes and slender turns that suits sustained reading.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: Ozone holds one stroke thickness everywhere, geometric and technical, with wide-set curve ends in every round form. Noto Serif Hentaigana softens things with mild, never stark contrast and open jaws on every curved stroke.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-ovo: Technical and geometric, Ozone runs a single neon-tube track width, while Ovo keeps a tall middle band with gentle stroke modulation. One stays flat, the other modulates gently, and that tension is the draw.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-mulish: Heavy letters with sweeping terminals that nearly touch the stem: that is Plakkaat. Mulish, modern and approachable, opens its sans apertures like a horseshoe magnet, so closed heading letters meet open body ones.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-bespoke-sans: Loose, breathing-room lettering with stubby ascenders: Quantum looks tech and clean. Bespoke Sans sits at a moderate lowercase height with generous space between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs move along crisply.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-fauna-one: Quantum keeps one flat line weight through every glyph, loosely spaced and tech-clean. Fauna One brings a literary, dignified serif voice, its tall middle band and open e making paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is classic and editorial, with a larger-than-usual x-height. Quantum draws a tube-like line that holds its thickness through every bend, and beside those open-ended curves that is the real difference.
